title: Astromechanics accepts malformed measurement replies as valid sky brightness
summary: Any positive section read is converted by indigo_atod without complete numeric parse validation; garbage newline becomes0 and OK, and numeric-prefix junk becomes a plausible reading. Validate complete finite device payloads and preserve previous data/ALERT on corruption; add fake serial malformed-reply checks. This concerns transport input, not framework property input. Fixed and reverified by the linked repair task; source and runtime limits remain recorded there.
